title: Two-sided tilting complexes over symmetric algebras sending simple modules to shifts of modules
summary: For a tilting complex over a finite-dimensional symmetric algebra over an algebraically closed field, whose distinct graded components have no indecomposable projective direct summands in common, we explicitly (re)construct a two-sided tilting complex that corresponds to the tilting complex, starting from a bimodule inducing a stable equivalence of Morita type.
